deadline.quote: The application submission deadline for physics is December 15.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE REQUIRED for the Fall 2027 cohort
gre_subject.quote: The GRE general test is recommended and the GRE physics subject test is required.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the Physics Graduate Admissions Committee.
supervisor.quote: The Physics Graduate Admissions Committee will review the applications and recommendations for admission are sent to the Graduate Studies Office.

funding.value: All doctoral students have full financial support (fellowships, research or teaching assistantships).
funding.quote: all doctoral students have full financial support in the form of internal or external fellowships, research assistantships, teaching assistantships, or some combination of fellowship and assistantship support.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree or equivalent; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have completed a bachelor's degree or the equivalent before beginning graduate study.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are requested inside the online application; eligibility rules are not stated on the department page
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are also requested and processed through the application process.

gre_general.value: Recommended, not required; considered if submitted
gre_general.quote: Important graduate admissions update for applicants to the Fall 2027 cohort: The GRE general test is recommended and the GRE physics subject test is required.

notes: Astronomy faculty can supervise physics students and vice versa.
